19445331: The meaning: a natural number is zero or one more than a natural number. This is the program; how the machine stores it is a separate choice.
46d00673: Written against Nat only. On the binary representation the same definition runs 18! in milliseconds; in unary it would need 6.4 quadrillion succ nodes.
018e2b8f: Peano-style recursion with match. It works unchanged on Binary, through match Nat′.
6b1adc26: A representation of Nat: little-endian bits. even(h) is 2h, odd(h) is 2h + 1, and there is never a leading zero, so each number has one spelling.
86e8ce2b: The abstraction function. Run forward it says what some bits mean; run backwards it encodes a Nat, canonical spelling first.
28fe4c57: A match on Nat, done on Binary: one function per case of Nat.
0b8a46b4: A fold on Nat, done on Binary. It is a fold over the bits, so it is still total.
